title: Connect an OpenAI-compatible provider
summary: Configure a cloud or compatible provider through the Model Workshop without sending credentials through the wiki agent.

steps.title: Review provider contract
steps.detail: Confirm the selected provider exposes the request/usage contract RESIDUAL expects.

steps.title: Open Model Workshop
steps.detail: Enter endpoint, model ID, and credentials in the Station's provider form. The wiki does not collect secrets.

steps.title: Run the provider test
steps.detail: Use Station's connection test and model discovery before allowing the route in a live mission.
